statements.statement: The patient has recurrent transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The provider ordered cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271)
The service is to evaluate for potential atrial fibrillation or another arrhythmia
The service is medically necessary to identify an arrhythmic source of the recurrent embolic events and guide management
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
